description: A PHP class that preprocesses numeric data by converting numbers to words in specified languages, leveraging Numbers_Words. It is used within an image graphing library context.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_NumberText
classes.description: A class that converts numeric values to their textual representation in a specified language, used as a data preprocessor within image graphing.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_NumberText
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the processor with a language and including the Numbers_Words library.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its word form in the specified language using Numbers_Words::toWords.
